description:
To install a ventilation system in the basement to overcome damp and condensation as well as providing a healthier environment.

If it is possible to make one or two vent openings in the rear wall this would facilitate the installation. There are other options available if this is not possible.

To provide an extractor fan in the Raised Ground Floor bathroom which would require an exterior vent.
To install a new bathroom to the rear of the Lower Ground Floor  be located below the bathroom in the floor above) There would be no structural changes to be made apart from making a wooden stud partition with a door.

The existing outdated kitchen needs to be replaced.

Some of the windows need repair and this will be done sympathetically rather than replacing them.

There would be no external changes to the appearance of the building and the minor internal changes would be in areas that have already been altered therefore having no impact on its Listed and Conservation Area status.

The owner is aware of the historical significance of the property and intends to retain as many of the remaining features as possible and will do everything in their power to repair the property and maintain it to a good standard.
decision_conditions:
The following list is information, details and plans which would need to be provided at a minimum to allow for assessment of any future application:

•	Elevation drawings should be provided showing in appropriate detail the external works proposed
•	A comprehensive and appropriately detailed Heritage Impact Statement, Internal and External Schedule of works and Methodology Statement
•	Basement ventilation system – confirmation of details of the proposed ventilation brick and its exact location drawn on elevation drawings 
•	Extractor fan – details of the proposed ventilation block and its exact location also on elevational drawings
•	Conversion of basement hallway to bathroom – Details of fixtures and fittings, information about the proposed partitioning and its construction
•	Windows – submission of a methodology plan to show how repairs are intended to be carried out. Any removal/repair of windows should be explained in the heritage statement (or methodology).
•	New doors need to be detailed in drawings.  Existing and proposed designs should be illustrated in drawings.  
•	Two boiler locations are provided. Appropriate plans should be provided which show a singular proposed location including how it will be installed to minimise impact on historic fabric. Appropriate justification and assessment should be provided in a heritage statement.  
•	Details regarding flooring, decorative skirting, guttering need to be provided. This needs to be set out and explained in the heritage statement regarding location, material and design and/or indicated on drawings.

Reference should be made to Council's Validation Checklist for further details:
https://www.richmond.gov.uk/media/18491/local_validation_checklist_for_all_applications.pdf
